TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY MAY 21, 2025 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In
order to conduct the meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to
discuss their concerns within a 3­minute time allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure
everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate your understanding and
cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394­6240 or email at
publicworks@sandimasca.gov.
COMMITTEE MEMBERS
Shari Garwick (Director of Public Works), Steve Barragan (Engineering Manager, Public Works Dept.),
Esau Ramos (Manager, Maintenance Yard), Detective Leo (San Dimas Sherriff’s Department) Ruben
Perales (Traffic Engineer), Rose Lee (BUSD Transportation Director), Genevieve Amaro (Management
Aide, Public Works Dept.)

INTRODUCTIONS

DISCUSSION ITEMS

05­25­01 Terrebonne Avenue and Lassen Court Vehicles Speeds
Request from Resident, concerned abut vehicles appearing to travel along Terrebonne Avenue to speeds
beyond the posted speed limit
05­25­02 Vehicles Exiting San Dimas Canyon Golf Course
Request from Resident, review and consider the installation of signage for vehicles exiting San Dimas
Canyon Golf Course on Terrebonne Avenue.
05­25­03 Vehicles Entering & Exiting Charter Oak Mobile Home Entrance/Exit Constantly
Blocked by traffic.
Request from Resident, concerned about vehicles appearing to block entrance/exit to Charter Oak Mobile
Home off Covina Boulevard.
05­25­04 Renwick and Shellman Avenue Vehicles Parking Concerns
Request from Resident, review parking concerns along Shellman Avenue.
05­25­05 Fifth Street and Monte Vista Avenue Dip Warning Concern
Request from Resident, review signage for advanced warning of dips for vehicles traveling along Fifth
Street and crossing Monte Vista Avenue.
05­25­06 N Shellman Avenue Speeding Concern
Request from Resident, concerned about vehicles appearing to travel along Shellman Avenue at speeds
beyond the posted speed limit.
05­25­07 Cars & Coffee City Event
Request from Staff, review application and site plan.
05­25­08 Shull Elementary Revise Current Parking Signage
 05­25­04 Renwick and Shellman Avenue Vehicles Parking Concerns
Request from Resident, review parking concerns along Shellman Avenue.
05­25­05 Fifth Street and Monte Vista Avenue Dip Warning Concern
Request from Resident, review signage for advanced warning of dips for vehicles traveling along Fifth
Street and crossing Monte Vista Avenue.
05­25­06 N Shellman Avenue Speeding Concern
Request from Resident, concerned about vehicles appearing to travel along Shellman Avenue at speeds
beyond the posted speed limit.
05­25­07 Cars & Coffee City Event
Request from Staff, review application and site plan.
05­25­08 Shull Elementary Revise Current Parking Signage
Request from Resident, to revise current signage that was installed in September Per Traffic Safety Item
09­24­06.
05­25­09 Red Curb Installation in Front of 920 N Amelia Avenue
Request from Resident, to consider red curb installation for line of sight concern. This Item was reviewed
at the November 2018 TSC Meeting, & July 2024 TSC Meeting.

CONTINUED ITEMS

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if
  you need assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office
  at (909) 394­6216. Early notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it
  possible for the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this
  meeting [28 CFR 35.102­35.104 ADA Title II].

Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any
writings or documents provided to the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made
available for public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30
a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the
City's website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on May 15, 2025, I posted a true and
correct copy of this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita
Ave., and on the City's website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas­minutes/as required by law.

  Genevieve Amaro
May 15, 2025
  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide
